title: Make room in the session
description: Moving or resizing either end of a session shifts its neighbors in both directions while preserving minimum durations and changeover time.
useCase: Edit a recording schedule or production timeline with collision handling and reversible ripple changes.
interaction: Drag a block to move it or either edge to resize. Focus a block or edge and use arrow keys in five-minute steps; Escape cancels the drag.
reducedMotion: Resizing the active block is immediate. Neighboring transform settling is disabled for keyboard input, reduced motion and inactive hosts. Pausing cancels the drag.
limitations: Local one-room schedule with five-minute steps and a fixed session order. Changes clamp to available space. Touching neighbors follow in either direction; free gaps absorb changes before distant blocks move. Changing count, gap or closing time resets the fixture.
look: A charcoal recording timeline with numbered lanes, broad orange and cool-toned time blocks, large duration figures and subtle ruler marks.
motion: A block moves from its body or resizes from either end. Adjacent blocks translate in either direction; shrinking a committed expansion brings displaced neighbors back. Dashed ghosts show the pre-drag state; release commits and Escape restores the chain.
adapt: `editSchedule` clamps movement and either resize boundary to packed neighbor bounds, then propagates collisions and connected gaps in both directions. Each drag reads a fixed snapshot. `fixture` supplies sessions; `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop configure count, changeover, closing time and transform settling.
